caseStudies.title: Classifying signals without promotion
caseStudies.scenarioSummary: A fictional service review combines event records, participant reports and analyst interpretations that must remain distinguishable.

observations: Two scheduled check-ins are recorded as missed.
A later check-in is recorded as completed.
reports: The fictional participant reports feeling overwhelmed.
A team member reports that reminders were sent.
inferences: The reminders may have changed later attendance.
unknowns: Why the two check-ins were missed.
Whether reminders affected the later check-in.

analysisPrompts: Classify each statement by evidence class.
Preserve the source and uncertainty attached to every inference.
caseStudies.decisionBoundary: The case supports classification practice only; it cannot establish a real person's state or promote an inference into evidence.

caseStudies.title: Reading a short demand shift
caseStudies.scenarioSummary: A fictional product team sees a short demand decline and produces competing explanations from incomplete information.

observations: Demand is lower for one week.
One distribution channel changed during the same period.
reports: A team member reports negative customer sentiment.
A channel lead reports delayed inventory updates.
inferences: The channel change caused the decline.

analysisPrompts: Write a reading bounded to the available time and evidence.
List plausible alternatives and the questions that remain open.
caseStudies.decisionBoundary: The case does not support diagnosis, causal certainty or a professional conclusion.

caseStudies.title: Navigating cost and contract constraints
caseStudies.scenarioSummary: A fictional household explores lower-cost service options while contractual, timing and information constraints remain material.

observations: The current monthly cost exceeds the stated target.
An early-exit condition remains active for three months.
reports: The household reports that service continuity matters.
A provider reports three available configurations.
inferences: The lowest listed price may best meet the goal.
unknowns: Future pricing after the contract period.
The household's tolerance for feature changes.

analysisPrompts: State the current reality position before listing options.
Map each option against the constraints without selecting one.
caseStudies.decisionBoundary: The case permits option and constraint mapping only; choice remains with the authorized decision-maker.

caseStudies.title: Reviewing a mixed workflow result
caseStudies.scenarioSummary: A fictional workflow revision produces lower waiting time and more correction events, creating a mixed continuation state.

observations: Average waiting time fell after the workflow revision.
Recorded correction events rose during the same review period.
reports: Staff report that handoffs feel faster.
inferences: Faster handoffs caused the correction increase.
unknowns: Whether staffing changed during the period.
Whether the result will persist over a longer interval.

analysisPrompts: Link the workflow change to each observed outcome without asserting causality.
Form a next review state that preserves unresolved uncertainty.
caseStudies.decisionBoundary: The case supports a traceable review frame, not proof of cause or an automatic continuation decision.

caseStudies.title: Separating formation from authority
caseStudies.scenarioSummary: A fictional facilitator has completed learning activities while credential, jurisdiction, entitlement and assignment gates remain independently governed.

observations: The learning sequence is marked complete.
No verified credential record is present in the scenario.
reports: The facilitator reports prior related experience.
An organization reports that assignment review is pending.
inferences: Prior experience implies current service entitlement.
unknowns: Whether credential evidence will be verified.
Whether jurisdiction and assignment conditions will be satisfied.

analysisPrompts: Separate learning, capability, credential, entitlement and assignment states.
Identify which authorities can resolve each remaining gate.
caseStudies.decisionBoundary: The case cannot grant or recommend credential, entitlement, assignment or professional authority.
